race.comment: PALTINIAN (4) brings a strong class angle, coming back from an Open at Wycheproof where he was third despite being steadied and held up late, with two placings from three tries around 1800m supporting the setup. TASSADAR (5) has to rebound from a plain last at Mornington, but that was metro company and he had been beaten only a neck by Cable De Vega at Moe the run prior; the quick back-up and first-time blinkers keep him right in calculations. DUSTY'S DEEL (13) was beaten just over a length by DUBAI LEGEND in a BM52 at Wycheproof as a well-supported favourite, respecting that market confidence. MANNERHEIM (2) mixes form but was solid at Avoca and has claims.
